label: Finding-121
title: NVD's CVSS 3.1 score of 9.8 is in the vault and nowhere on the site
description: The vault's raw NVD API captures (nvd-cve-2026-109618 and nvd-cve-2026-109619, raw/nvd-api-2.0.json) carry NIST's own CVSS 3.1 base score 9.8 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H) beside the vendor's CVSS 4.0 9.2; a fetch of the NVD API at 18:27 UTC on 22 October shows the same. No claim, number, glossary entry or page mentions 9.8. A reader or a scanner using CVSS 3.1 sees 9.8 and finds no explanation here. See K-007.
